messages:
Noah Bennett: quick sync — partners keep asking for a single onboarding checklist that covers HSM/KMS, SCIM provisioning, and SSO. can we lock the gating criteria today?
Aisha Kapoor: from security: minimal must-haves = key-wrap/unwrap test vectors, delta SCIM, SAML SP- and IdP-initiated flows, and audit-log export. also want a signed attestation artifact for HSM vendors.
Tom Reyes: marketplace note: we need predictable attribution. propose referral token + webhook reconciliation. commercial bands: Referral (low-touch): 88/12, SI services: 70/30, Co-sell: negotiated.
Aisha Kapoor: add perf gating: sandbox p95 key-wrap < 150ms for Certified, Pilot can be 300ms. require a rotation demo (automated).
Noah Bennett: GTM suggestion: three tiers — Pilot (fast, small credit), Validated (listed in marketplace), Enterprise (SLA + joint GTM). Pilot turnaround target 2w, Validated 4-6w.
Tom Reyes: ops prefers self-service sandbox signup with rate-limited keys to speed pilots. we'll add telemetry fields to the report: keywrap_p95_ms, rotation_success_rate, scim_delta_errors.
sec-bot: created PR #701: partners/onboarding/hsm-kms-scim-sso-playbook.md — https://git.redwood.co/pr/701
Aisha Kapoor: security will push a short appendix with PKCS#11 sample vector and a small test script. example vector snippet:
```
# expected 32-byte plaintext for vector-01
HEX_IN: 3f8a...9c
WRAPPED: base64(...)
```
Tom Reyes: I'll draft the partner-facing page and the webhook spec. legal: please review DPA before public listing — tagging legal in the tracker.
Noah Bennett: action items: Tom=partner page + webhook, Aisha=security appendix + vectors, Ops=enable self-service sandbox, Legal=confirm DPA. target: draft Monday internal review, partner preview Wednesday, publish next Monday. Thanks — quick 30m sign-off tomorrow? :thumbsup:
